⚡ Navigation & Booking Shortcuts

  • Hiking Trails Overlay: Click any orange trail line to inspect distance, elevation gain, difficulty, and connected campgrounds.
  • Peaks & Lakes: Click peak badges ⛰️ (e.g. Mount Whitney 14,505', Half Dome) or lakes 💧 for elevations and geography.
  • ReserveCalifornia: 6 months rolling at 8:00:00 AM PT.
  • Recreation.gov: 6 months rolling at 7:00:00 AM PT. Yosemite opens on the 15th monthly.
